title: Domain Driven Design
text: . Now that we have explored business domains and subdomains, let's touch on an important concept for future discussions. Domain experts. These are the subject matter experts who deeply understand the business we are modeling and implementing in a software. Domain experts aren't the analyst gathering requirements or the engineers designing the system. They are the ones who identified the business problem and hold the knowledge we are translating into software
